5 Appendix 5.1 Survey Data Generation #generation of data based on entries in the hospital data # if there are 20 hospitals, make 20 random months for survey between 1 and 12 and random years choosing between 2016 and 2020 # https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/en/pub/13-26-0001/2020001/ODHF_v1.1.zip # make sure the latitude and longitude columns exist and that there is an id column as well set.seed(933) odhf <- read.csv("./data/odhf_v1.1.csv") odhf$hospital_id <- 1:nrow(odhf) odhf_valid <- odhf[!is.na(odhf[["latitude"]]) & !is.na(odhf[["longitude"]]), ] odhf_valid <- odhf_valid %>% filter(odhf_facility_type=="Hospitals") %>% select(c("latitude", "longitude", "facility_name", "odhf_facility_type", "source_facility_type", "hospital_id")) odhf_valid[[survey_month_col]] <- sample(1:12, size = nrow(odhf_valid), replace = TRUE) odhf_valid[[survey_year_col]] <- sample(2018:2021, size=nrow(odhf_valid), replace = TRUE) setnames(odhf_valid, c("latitude", "longitude"), c("lat","long")) write.csv(odhf_valid, "./data/odhf_hospitals.csv")
